name: M3_MWS121MI_LstAcqByCUOR
description: List all preallocated acquisition orders that are linked to demand order lines belonging to a customer order with a given customer's order number. The operation reads the preallocation links between demand orders (for example customer orders) and acquisition orders (for example firm or planned manufacturing orders) and returns one record per link. Each record includes both demand and acquisition order identities, together with item, quantity, planning and expiration dates, and schedule number. Preallocation reserves a quantity on a supplying order in advance for a specific demand order line.

inputParameters.name: CUOR
inputParameters.description: Customer's own order number used to select related preallocated acquisition orders.

inputParameters.name: DOCA
inputParameters.description: Demand order category used to limit which demand orders are considered when listing acquisition orders.

inputParameters.name: DRDN
inputParameters.description: Demand order number used to restrict the list to preallocations for a specific demand order.

inputParameters.name: DRDL
inputParameters.description: Demand order line number used to restrict the list to a specific demand order line.

inputParameters.name: DRDX
inputParameters.description: Optional line suffix used to restrict the list to a specific sequence within the demand order line.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the preallocation record.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the preallocated acquisition order line is held or planned.

outputParameters.name: CUOR
outputParameters.description: Customer's own order number referenced on the demand order.

outputParameters.name: DOCA
outputParameters.description: Demand order category of the preallocated demand order.

outputParameters.name: DRDN
outputParameters.description: Demand order number of the preallocated demand order.

outputParameters.name: DRDL
outputParameters.description: Demand order line number of the preallocated demand order line.

outputParameters.name: DRDX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying the sequence within the preallocated demand order line.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number on the preallocated acquisition order line.

outputParameters.name: AOCA
outputParameters.description: Acquisition order category of the supplying order linked to the demand order.

outputParameters.name: ARDN
outputParameters.description: Acquisition order number of the supplying order linked to the demand order.

outputParameters.name: ARDL
outputParameters.description: Acquisition order line number of the preallocated acquisition order line.

outputParameters.name: ARDX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying the sequence within the preallocated acquisition order line.

outputParameters.name: TRQT
outputParameters.description: Transaction quantity in the item's basic unit of measure on the acquisition order line.

outputParameters.name: PQTT
outputParameters.description: Total quantity preallocated on the acquisition order line.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Planning date when this preallocation affects the material plan.

outputParameters.name: PANQ
outputParameters.description: Net quantity on the acquisition order line that is still available for preallocation.

outputParameters.name: PQTY
outputParameters.description: Quantity preallocated from the acquisition order line to this demand order line.

outputParameters.name: EXPI
outputParameters.description: Expiration date for the item or lot on the acquisition order line.

outputParameters.name: SCHN
outputParameters.description: Schedule number associated with the preallocated acquisition order for production planning.
